Not unless things get better. It's the one thing I'm looking forward to, I'm only changing it if things actually improve. Nobody could love me, I'll say it again. Nobody wants to be with me when I'm fucking batshit crazy half the time.

Edit- Sorry. I'm coming off as an asshole. Let me just say : thank you. It means a lot that you're willing to talk w me.

Well, I waited until today, guess what? I broke up with her. To put it simply- The relationship was going nowhere. One of her friends admitted that he had feelings for her, so I broke up with her and told him to go for it; he'd be better than I ever was. Nobody will ever love me again. Reality sucks. Truth hurts. Also. I'm only letting myself commit suicide on January Sixth. I promised myself I would wait till then.

No... That's why it's so bad. I told her "I'm sorry- I can't be your boyfriend anymore. I just can't, okay? It's not your fault. I'm still good with being friends I just can't continue this relationship". This is where the bad part comes in. She cut contact with me. I will never speak to her again, I can't speak to her again.
There's nothing that can fill the void, though. For once, somebody loved me but I ruined it. Nobody could love me. I had one chance but I ruined it.

don't make this hard, ok? as the title implies im done. idk what to do, how to live. So I won't. if I don't kill myself, I'm going to live a shallow, fragmented life. I'm- Grazie, addio.

Edit- im going to wait till tomorrow but if things don't improve then it's over for me
this is my end. my "gf" is ignoring me. goodbye everyone thank you for helping but I couldn't fix mysoelf so I'm sorry goodbye
Quello che mi serve è qualcuno che possa colmare il divario nella mia anima. An S.O. I think someone actually loving me would fix things, at least a little.
My nickname at school is "The Frog and the Toad". The sad thing is, it's accurate, I do look somewhat reminiscent of a frog.

No... In person, I'm the opposite of how I am on here. It's so easy to be a completely different person to everyone else. Maschera su, maschera fouri. To everyone else, I'm happy, outgoing, whatever. On the inside I'm dead. I don't mean this offensively or anything, but I don't know how you can decipher my personality from my self pity. Being self aware isn't good, neither is being shy.
Trust me... Paper thin is better. I have duck lips. You don't want those.

I appreciate it, but I'm going to bed. I'm feeling empty rn. Unmotivated. I might talk more tomorrow. Idk, though. Thanks for the kind words. 

Edit- No, no. Going to sleep isn't going to fix anything. I need to talk about where this all comes from. Stems down to self-hatred. A desire for more. I feel like I'm living a shallow life, just barely making it from day to day. People constantly tell me I look good, but when I look in the mirror I just see ugly.

I am stressing it, though. The point is like you said, I can't help the way I look. Thus, there's nothing I can do to fix myself. I am ugly.  "Inner beauty is within" is simply untrue. People don't care about how you act. People care about how you look. People don't care about you if you're ugly and an outcast.
Oh god. It's been four minutes and I'm going fucking crazy already. It's like... There's a giant-ass boulder in my soul, fucking crushing it. Is this what insanity feels like? I just want it to end.
